events.title: Pepin of Herstal, ruler of the Franks, dies
events.description: Pepin of Herstal, the mayor of the palace who held real power over the Frankish kingdoms, died at Jupille. After a struggle, his son Charles Martel took control and laid the ground for the Carolingian dynasty.
events.html: Pepin of Herstal, the mayor of the palace who held real power over the Frankish kingdoms, died at Jupille. After a struggle, his son Charles Martel took control and laid the ground for the Carolingian dynasty.

events.title: An Lushan launches his rebellion against the Tang
events.description: An Lushan, a Tang frontier general of Sogdian and Turkic descent, rose in revolt against his rival, the chancellor Yang Guozhong. The rebellion lasted until 763, captured both Tang capitals and permanently weakened central authority.

events.title: Henry VI is crowned king of France in Paris
events.description: The ten-year-old Henry VI of England was crowned king of France at Notre-Dame. By 1453 the English had lost all their French lands except Calais.
events.html: The ten-year-old Henry VI of England was crowned king of France at Notre-Dame. By 1453 the English had lost all their French lands except Calais.

events.title: Admiral Yi Sun-sin is killed in the victory at Noryang
events.description: A combined Korean and Ming fleet under Yi Sun-sin and Chen Lin attacked Japanese ships gathering in the Noryang Strait to withdraw, sinking a large number. Yi was killed in this last major battle of the Imjin War.

events.title: The Boston Tea Party
events.description: Colonists, some disguised as Mohawk Indians, boarded three ships in Boston Harbor and threw 342 chests of East India Company tea into the water. Britain's punitive response pushed the colonies towards revolution.
events.html: Colonists, some disguised as Mohawk Indians, boarded three ships in Boston Harbor and threw 342 chests of East India Company tea into the water. Britain's punitive response pushed the colonies towards revolution.

events.title: Voortrekkers defeat a Zulu army at Blood River
events.description: A laager of about 470 Voortrekkers repelled thousands of Zulu warriors sent by King Dingane at the Ncome River. The victory became a central symbol of Afrikaner nationalism.
events.html: A laager of about 470 Voortrekkers repelled thousands of Zulu warriors sent by King Dingane at the Ncome River. The victory became a central symbol of Afrikaner nationalism.

events.title: Germany launches the Battle of the Bulge
events.description: German forces attacked through the Ardennes in Belgium and Luxembourg, catching the Americans by surprise. The offensive was contained within weeks and used up Germany's last reserves in the west.

events.title: Kazakhstan declares independence
events.description: Kazakhstan became the last Soviet republic to declare independence, days before the USSR was dissolved. Nursultan Nazarbayev led the vast Central Asian country for nearly three decades.
